Andhra Pradesh Reports Omicron RF.5 Variant, Health Minister Assures No Need to Panic

Andhra Pradesh has reported 12 new COVID-19 cases and four deaths over the past three weeks. The state's health minister has confirmed the presence of the Omicron RF.5 variant but downplays concerns, stating there is no need to panic. This development comes as some doctors have expressed caution due to the resurfacing of COVID-19 in the region.
